en.title: Maximum Minus Signs While Keeping Every Prefix Strictly Positive
en.description:
Assign a plus or minus sign to each element of an array of positive integers so that the signed sum of every non-empty prefix is strictly greater than 0. Maximize the number of minus signs.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; bounds supplemented where the source lacks them and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the specification.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n integers. Original bounds: 1≤n≤100000, 1≤a[i]≤10^9; a prefix sum of 0 is invalid.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 1; 3; 1. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Negate each new element first and push it into a max-heap; if the prefix is not positive, undo the negation of the element with the largest absolute value among all currently negated elements.
